    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    divider = next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == 2 for x in row)), None)

        return out
    marker = next((x for row in grid for x in row if x not in (0,2)), None)
    if marker is None:
        return out
    # The upper marker is a horizontal bar and the lower marker indicates
    # which column to connect; paint that column from the bar to divider.
    upper = [r for r in range(divider) if marker in grid[r]]
    lower = [r for r in range(divider+1, rows) if marker in grid[r]]
    if not upper or not lower:
        return out

    lower_cols = [c for c,v in enumerate(grid[lower_row]) if v == marker]

    # the demonstrated shape.
    col = min(upper_cols)
    for r in range(upper_row+1, divider):
        if grid[r][col] == 0:
            out[r][col] = marker + 1
    return out

    lower_rows = [r for r in range(divider + 1, len(grid)) if marker in grid[r]]
    if upper_rows and lower_rows:
        upper = grid[min(upper_rows)]
        lower = grid[max(lower_rows)]
        uc = [c for c, v in enumerate(upper) if v == marker]
        lc = [c for c, v in enumerate(lower) if v == marker]
        if uc and lc:
            # Vertical connector follows the common column alignment; if the
            # marker bars don't share one, choose the endpoint of the bottom bar.
            common = set(uc) & set(lc)
            c = min(common) if common else min(lc)
            color = marker + 1
            for r in range(min(upper_rows) + 1, divider):
                if grid[r][c] == 0:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    divider = next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    if divider is None: return out
    marker = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,2)), None)
    if marker is None: return out
    top_rows = [r for r in range(divider) if marker in grid[r]]
    bot_rows = [r for r in range(divider+1,len(grid)) if marker in grid[r]]
    if not top_rows or not bot_rows: return out
    top_r, bot_r = min(top_rows), max(bot_rows)
    top_cols = [c for c,v in enumerate(grid[top_r]) if v == marker]
    bot_cols = [c for c,v in enumerate(grid[bot_r]) if v == marker]
    if not top_cols or not bot_cols: return out
    left, right = min(top_cols), max(top_cols)
    # Fill the intersection of the two endpoint bars across the open gap.
    # Demos: the overlapping columns 2..4 are colored 4.
    lo, hi = max(left, min(bot_cols)), min(right, max(bot_cols))
    if lo > hi:
        return out
    for r in range(top_r+1, divider):
        for c in range(lo, hi+1):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
